title: Ba Na Hills & The Golden Bridge (Danang)
description: Ascend via one of the world's longest cable cars to the iconic Golden Bridge—two massive stone hands cradling a golden walkway over the Danang clouds.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Ba Na Hills, a former French colonial hill station in Danang, offers a 6-hour "Scenic, Architectural, Cinematic" experience, featuring the Golden Bridge and French Village. This itinerary is best paired with a day off from golf in Central [Vietnam](/destinations/vietnam/).
> *   The experience includes a 20-minute cable car ascent, one of the world's longest, providing views of the Annamite mountain range. AGS provides VIP access to bypass queues and ensures optimal photography at the Golden Bridge before mid-morning rush.
> *   AGS bookings guarantee priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers, eliminating logistical friction. Advance booking is strictly required for this year-round operation.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Ascend via one of the world's longest cable cars to the iconic Golden Bridge—two massive stone hands cradling a golden walkway over the Danang clouds.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Originally a French colonial hill station designed to escape the coastal heat, Ba Na Hills has been transformed into a sprawling, surreal mountaintop theme park and architectural marvel.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Bypass the massive queues with VIP access to the cable car system. The 20-minute ascent provides spectacular views of the Annamite mountain range. 

Arrive directly at the Golden Bridge before the mid-morning rush for optimal photography. Explore the surrounding French Village, the extensive flower gardens, and the Linh Ung Pagoda before descending for lunch in Danang city.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Scenic, Architectural, Cinematic |
| **Duration** | 6 Hours (Morning/Afternoon) |
| **Physical Demand** | Moderate (Walking) |
| **Best Paired With** | A day off from golf in Central Vietnam. |

## Combining the Golden Bridge Cable Car With Luke Donald’s Ba Na Hills Golf Club
Unlike almost any other sightseeing landmark in Southeast Asia, **Ba Na Hills & The Golden Bridge** sits at the exact same mountain base station as Luke Donald’s award-winning [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/) (Par 72, 7,858 yards)—just 35 minutes west of coastal Da Nang resorts like [InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/intercontinental-danang/), [TIA Wellness Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/tia-wellness-resort-danang/), and [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/). Because the IMG-managed championship course occupies the lush valley floor at the foot of the cable car towers—and features full tournament-grade LED floodlighting across all 18 holes—Asia Golf Specialists engineers a seamless single-day mountain doubleheader that avoids every tourist bottleneck:

1. **07:30 AM VIP Priority Cable Car to the Golden Bridge:** Depart your Da Nang or Hoi An resort at 06:45 AM to board the Guinness World Record single-wire cable car via the VIP priority lane as the gates open. At 1,414 meters above sea level, the air is 7°C–10°C cooler than the coast, and you walk across the 150-meter Golden Bridge (*Cầu Vàng*) held aloft by two giant weathered stone hands before the 9:30 AM tour-bus wave arrives.
2. **11:30 AM Descent & Clubhouse Lunch at Ba Na Hills Golf Club:** Ride the cable car back down the mountain directly to the base station and transfer five minutes to the clubhouse at [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/) for a lakeside lunch.
3. **1:00 PM or 2:30 PM Afternoon/Twilight Championship Round:** Tee off on Luke Donald’s dramatic mountain layout—where elevation drops, timber-framed bunkers, and zero coastal wind create a complete contrast to [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/)—finishing your closing holes under the floodlights in cool mountain air.

## Ideal Resort Bases & Central Coast Tour Integration
Travelers staying at [InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/intercontinental-danang/), [TIA Wellness Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/tia-wellness-resort-danang/), [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/), or our private [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) can incorporate this morning Golden Bridge cable car ascent and afternoon [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/) tee time seamlessly into [The Coastal Sprint](/tours/the-coastal-sprint/) or [Vietnam Central Coast](/tours/vietnam-central-coast/).

faqs.q: How close is the Golden Bridge cable car to Ba Na Hills Golf Club in Da Nang?
faqs.a: The Ba Na Hills cable car base station sits less than 5 minutes from the clubhouse of Luke Donald's Ba Na Hills Golf Club, located 35 minutes west of downtown Da Nang in the Truong Son foothills.

faqs.q: Can we visit the Golden Bridge and play 18 holes at Ba Na Hills Golf Club on the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Our signature pairing takes the VIP priority cable car up to the Golden Bridge at 7:30 AM to beat the crowds, descends at 11:00 AM for lunch at the Ba Na Hills Golf Club clubhouse, and tees off at 1:00 PM (finishing under the course's championship floodlights).

faqs.q: How does Asia Golf Specialists help golf groups avoid the cable car queues at Ba Na Hills?
faqs.a: We pre-issue VIP WOW Pass priority boarding tickets and time your departure for the 7:30 AM opening window, allowing your group to bypass general queues at both the base and summit cable car stations.
